idea-plugin.name: Tiling Blue
idea-plugin.description:
A dark, square-cornered theme that turns the IDE into a set of blue-outlined tiles on a near-black background, with red marking whatever has focus. Borrowed from the wargames palette of rejeb.is-a.dev.
  • Two UI themes in the same colours: Tiling Blue Island Dark (the default), based on Islands Dark: framed panels with gaps between them, editor tabs as outlined boxes (as in earlier versions); and Tiling Blue Dark, based on Dark: tool windows and editor side by side with blue borders, full-height tabs underlined in red with lines between them. Both: red selected tab, blue selection, square buttons and popups
  • The lines between editor tabs in Tiling Blue Dark are IntelliJ's registry setting ide.new.editor.tabs.vertical.borders: the theme turns it on while it is active and off again when you choose another theme (unless you had turned it on yourself). With that setting on, the theme also draws the line after the last tab, which IntelliJ leaves out
  • Matching editor color scheme Tiling Blue (syntax, diff, VCS, console, terminal)
  • Tiled loading animations: the spinner is four tiles with focus moving clockwise (from the next restart after choosing the theme), and progress bars are rows of segments that fill up, with a soft wave rolling along them while the length is unknown
  • On Linux/Wayland, dialog and welcome-screen title bars are themed too (they are drawn with GTK there; the theme restyles them inside the IDE only, without installing a GTK theme)
  • Solid icons: flat tiles in the theme's colours for the tool windows, toolbars, trees and gutter; square checkboxes and window buttons
  • IBM Plex Mono 14 bundled (SIL Open Font License) for the editor and the UI. If you picked your own UI font, the theme asks before replacing it, and gives your font back when you switch themes
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.1.0: Two themes: Tiling Blue Island Dark (the default, based on Islands Dark: the theme of earlier versions renamed, with the same editor tabs) and the new Tiling Blue Dark, based on Dark: full-height 36 px editor tabs with lines between them and after the last one, 34 px tool window headers, underlined tool window tabs, blue borders around the editor tabs and tool windows; Solid icon set; IBM Plex Mono 14 bundled for the editor and the UI (asks before replacing a custom UI font, restores it when you leave the theme); window closer to the design: 30 px toolbar buttons, narrower tool window stripes, 30 px status bar, square checkboxes, framed dialogs, blue scrollbars, ink icons on a focused selection; offers a restart for the tiled loading spinner when the theme is installed or chosen without one; uninstalling leaves no title bar listener or progress bar class of the plugin behind.
1.0.1 and earlier: Initial release: Tiling Blue UI theme, matching Tiling Blue editor color scheme, tiled loading spinner and segmented progress bars, and themed dialog title bars on Linux/Wayland.
